name: Inner Mongolia First Machinery Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Inner Mongolia First Machinery Group Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, and manufacture of battle tanks, wheeled armored vehicles, and medium-caliber artillery in China and internationally. It offers railway vehicle; construction machinery; explosion-proof and emergency response equipment; emergency rescue equipment; public health equipment; agricultural machinery and equipment; petroleum machinery; new energy equipment; special purpose vehicles; and vehicle parts. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Baotou, China.
